settings.eyebrow: Everly & Co. · Full-service wedding planning · Est. 2014
settings.headline:
Your wedding, planned with care —
and zero stress.
settings.copy: Everly & Co. is a full-service wedding planning studio. From the first venue tour to the last dance, we handle the details so you can be fully present for the moments that matter. No spreadsheets on your honeymoon. No vendor chasing at 11pm. Just a wedding that feels unmistakably yours.

trust_list.text: One dedicated planner from day one

settings.title: A decade of
settings.intro: We've planned everything from intimate elopements to 300-guest celebrations. The numbers tell the story of the trust couples place in us.

settings.title: From first hello
settings.intro: A clear, calm process that keeps you in control without the overwhelm. You'll always know what's next and who's handling it.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: We start with a coffee and a conversation about your vision, your budget, and the kind of day you want. No pressure, just clarity.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We build a moodboard, a venue shortlist, and a realistic budget that reflects your priorities — not a template.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: We book and manage every vendor, negotiate contracts, and build a detailed timeline so nothing slips through the cracks.

steps.title: Coordinate
steps.text: In the final weeks we run rehearsals, confirm every detail, and take over day-of logistics so you can simply enjoy it.

steps.title: Celebrate
steps.text: You dance, you toast, you soak it in. We handle the hiccups quietly in the background and make sure the day runs on time.

settings.note: Most couples tell us the same thing after the wedding: they were more relaxed than they ever expected to be.

settings.title: Planning that feels
settings.intro: We're not a factory. Every wedding is designed around the two of you — your story, your style, your people.

features.title: One dedicated planner
features.text: You work with the same person from the first call to the last dance. No hand-offs, no repeating your story.

features.title: Budget that's honest
features.text: We show you exactly where every dollar goes and help you spend on what you'll actually remember.

features.title: Vendors we trust
features.text: A vetted network of photographers, florists, caterers, and venues we've worked with for years.

features.title: Day-of calm
features.text: On the big day, we run the show. You're a guest at your own wedding — the best kind of guest.

settings.title: Moments we've
settings.intro: A glimpse of the celebrations we've designed — from garden ceremonies to grand ballrooms.

settings.intro: The best part of our job is hearing how couples felt on their day — and long after.

reviews.quote: Everly & Co. made our wedding feel effortless. We never once felt stressed, and the day was more beautiful than we imagined. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Maya & Jordan

reviews.quote: Our planner was a calm, brilliant force. She handled a vendor emergency mid-reception and we didn't even notice until she told us after. Unreal.

reviews.quote: We came in with a tight budget and a big vision. Everly & Co. made it work — and made it feel like a million bucks. We can't recommend them enough.
